description: This file defines interfaces and classes for load generator scenarios in a distributed testing framework, including implementations for ping and fan-out scenarios.

classes.name: ILoadGeneratorScenario<TState>
classes.description: An interface defining a load generator scenario with methods for retrieving its name, getting state for a worker, and issuing requests.

classes.name: PingScenario
classes.description: Implements a ping-based scenario where each worker pings a grain.

classes.name: FanOutScenario
classes.description: Implements a fan-out scenario where each worker interacts with a tree grain.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the scenario.

methods.name: GetStateForWorker
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the grain state for a specific worker.

methods.name: IssueRequest
methods.description: Issues a request to the grain, such as ping or other operation.
